text:
maya: FYI folks — planning the Thursday release rail for the infra sprint. Need owners for three deploy lanes and smoke checks. Can ppl claim? Windows: Thu 18:00-19:30 UTC. Components: runtime (model-serving), api-gateway, console. We want smoke + rollback owner per lane. TL;DR please reply with lane + smoke owner + rollback tag.

alex: I'll take runtime. I can be smoke owner and rollback on-call. ETA prep: will push canary at 18:05. :thumbsup:

rui: I'll take api-gateway but need a hand for smoke validations (canary health + perf). tagging @jamie for help.

jamie: I can assist with api smoke checks. Will run perf script. Send me the canary URL and expected latency SLO.

maya: rui/jamie — can you coordinate offline? add smoke checklist:
- metrics check (5xx/latency)
- end-to-end login flow
- KV cache warm
Paste snippet for perf test:
```bash
./tools/perf_check.sh --target https://canary-api.internal --rps 50 --duration 60
```

ops-rotation: rollback readiness: ensure image tag pinned and DB migration reversible. Also make rollback runbook entry: /playbooks/rollbacks/2026-03-runtime.md

alex: runtime note — using new quantization profile; if tokens spike, fallback to v2 model (image tag: redwood/runtime:v2-fallback). I'll update rollout with canary percentage.

deploy-bot: Scheduled window created: Thu 2026-03-19 18:00 UTC. Notifying infra for reserved capacity. (automated)

maya: jamie — expected perf baseline 95th < 120ms. rui — can you set canary to 5% for first 10m then 25% if stable?

rui: yep can do. I'll post exact canary URL ~10m before.

jamie: confirmed. I'll run the perf script and post results in thread.

alex: putting rollback steps inline:
1. switch traffic to blue
2. redeploy runtime:v2-fallback
3. clear kv cache
4. monitor for 10m

maya: awesome. If nobody else claims console, I'll take console smoke but not full rollback. Need someone to own rollback of console — volunteers?

sam: I can take console rollback owner and smoke check.

maya: perfect. Final check: owners list: runtime -> alex (smoke+rollback), api -> rui+jamie (smoke), console -> maya + sam (rollback). If anything changes, reply here. Otherwise, I'll lock the release train at EOD.

alex: noted. I'll post readiness checklist 30m before.

rui: same.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: capacity reserved. :white_check_mark:
